AutoElectricProcessingRate.definition: The number of cars processed per hour by one automatic electric jack.

AutoElectricElectricityUsage.definition: Units of electricity used per hour by one automatic electric jack.

GasPoweredProcessingRate.definition: The number of cars processed per hour by one gas-powered jack.

GasPoweredGasUsage.definition: Units of gas used per hour by one gas-powered jack.

MaxAutoElectricJacks.definition: The maximum number of automatic electric jacks that can be used.

MaxElectricityUnits.definition: The maximum units of electricity available.

MaxGasUnits.definition: The maximum units of gas available.
